reviews.text: I have a little experience of exchanging old gold ornaments for new ones. I have found that P.C. Chandra Jewellers gives a fair deal on gold exchange. I have exchanged non-hallmarked 91.6% pure gold in this showroom and received the complete exchange value for gold. There was no deduction in the weight of gold or the cost per gram of gold during the aforementioned exchange. Some of the other big gold brands in the city were not willing to offer such a deal. I have also exchanged 75% and 78% pure gold which correspond to 18K and a little above 18K purity, from this showroom. There was a deduction, perhaps slightly on the higher side, in the weight of gold as there should be since the calculation is based on the price of 91.6% pure gold. If one takes into account the price of 18K gold on the day, it was again a fair deal. In the first instance, the old ornaments were cut into smaller pieces to ascertain the purity of gold possibly by using a Karat meter while in the second case, the visibly less pure gold ornaments were first melted and solidified and then the purity of gold was checked. The process is quite transparent. I felt that the designs of gold ornaments were exquisite. The making charge of gold ornaments was 18% of the value of gold. The salespersons were courteous, I am quite happy with my experience in this showroom.

Had an excellent experience at the showroom. Would especially mention Saptarsee for excellent customer service. He is very knowledgeable and guided us well in our buying journey. Helped identify the right product according to our taste and budget and also informed us about the upcoming discount offer that helped us save 15% on the making charges. Kudos!
Huge jewelry showroom of P C Chandra Jewellers on Diamond Harbour Road, Behala. Good service. Parking is a problem. Expensive.
Very homely and welcoming attitude . Treats customers with immense patience and has mesmerizing collection.
